source_evidence.source_title: Wear Resistance Mechanism of Alumina Ceramics Containing Gd2O3
source_evidence.source_span: Excellent wear resistance of alumina ceramics is a desirable quality for many products. The purpose of this work was to improve the wear resistance of 99% alumina ceramics in an Al2O3-Gd2O3-SiO2-CaO-MgO (AGSCM) system. The content of Gd2O3 varied from 0.01% to 1%. A test of wear rate was performed in this study. Gd2O3 could refine grain size, form compressive stress of the grain boundary, and promote the crystallization of CaO-Al2O3-2SiO2 and CaO-MgO-2Al2O3-5SiO2. These changes resulted in the improvement of wear resistance.
